desc:
🌍 **WELCOME TO BORDER CROSSING TYCOON!** 🚧

💰 Build your own border crossing empire from scratch! Start with a small checkpoint, earn cash, unlock new buildings, and turn your island into a massive business empire!

🏗️ **BUILD & EXPAND** – Unlock hundreds of upgrades and develop your own border crossing!

🚗 **MANAGE TRAFFIC** – Earn money from cars, buses, trucks, and customers!

🛍️ **GROW YOUR BUSINESS** – Build a gas station, Duty Free shopping center, fast food restaurant, and warehouse!

🚢 **EXPAND YOUR PORT** – Develop a commercial harbor with cargo ships and massive cranes!

🪖 **BUILD A MILITARY BASE** – Unlock military facilities, tanks, and special funding!

🏎️ **UNLOCK VEHICLES** – Drive sports cars, race across the water in speedboats, or explore the map in a helicopter!

👥 **PLAY WITH FRIENDS** – Up to 4 players per server, each with their own island!

⭐ Can you build the ultimate border crossing empire?

👍 Like the game and ⭐ Favorite it for more updates!
